t: What Medical Waste Management Database Is All About
title: What Medical Waste Management Database Is All About
description: Healthcare waste splits into streams: general (like household), infectious (red bags), sharps (puncture-proof containers), pharmaceutical, and radioactive — each with its own handling. Only ~15% is hazardous, but mixing ruins the ratio. Autoclaving (steam sterilization) and incineration are the workhorses; segregation at the bedside decides everything downstream. This database is the complete waste stream: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
